column1: # Foreign-path classification — the 25 tracked files the source-scope
# foreign-path class blocks, measured 2026-08-26 against the class's own
# predicate. INPUT to the operator's per-file keep-or-scrub verdict; this
# file takes no such verdict and proposes none.
# NO TOKEN IS REPRODUCED HERE. The file is about home-shaped paths, so
# counts and owner labels are the whole content — writing an example would
# be the defect it exists to measure.
# distinct_tokens = distinct non-exempt home-shaped strings in the file.
# Exempt ones (this repo's own root, the XDG roots) are not counted: they
# are not why the file blocks.
# OWNER VOCABULARY. The brief specified two values; the measured population
# needs four, and the extra two are surfaced as a gap rather than folded
#   this_repo             a checkout or worktree of THIS repo at another
#                         operating prose about its own checkout
#   another_project       a different real project under this machine's home
#   machine_tool_state    this machine's Claude config/state area, not a
#   synthetic_placeholder not a live path on this machine: a placeholder
#                         username, a regex fragment, or an ellipsis in
# Rule, applied mechanically: a token under this machine's home is real and
# is bucketed by what it names; a token under any other user is a
# placeholder by construction. The rule is stated so the operator can
# re-derive any row rather than trust it.
